keyEvents.text: Jádson (Athletico Paranaense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Athletico Paranaense 1, Vasco da Gama 0. Steven Mendoza (Athletico Paranaense) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luiz Gustavo.
Delay in match because of an injury Steven Mendoza (Athletico Paranaense).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Vasco da Gama. Bruno Duarte replaces Brenner.
Substitution, Vasco da Gama. Facundo Colidio replaces Santiago Sosa.
Substitution, Athletico Paranaense. João Cruz replaces Steven Mendoza because of an injury.
Second Half begins Athletico Paranaense 1, Vasco da Gama 0.
Alan Lescano (Vasco da Gama) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
